Frequently Asked Questions

What is AVIF and why is it better?

AVIF is a next-generation image format based on the AV1 video codec. It offers superior compression compared to JPEG, PNG, and even WebP, typically achieving 30-50% smaller file sizes than JPEG while maintaining better visual quality. It's the future of web images.

Which browsers support AVIF?

AVIF is supported by Chrome 85+, Firefox 93+, Safari 16+, and Edge 121+. Support is rapidly expanding across all modern browsers, making it a safe choice for progressive enhancement.

Is my data secure?

Yes, all processing happens in your browser. Your images are never uploaded to any server, ensuring complete privacy and security.

Can I convert multiple images?

Yes! Our tool supports batch conversion. Select multiple files to convert them all at once.
